text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I watched your training.
Hehe... It's truly amazing how dedicated you are,
even while doing your ramen research on the side.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"If there is anything I can do to help,
please let me know, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
From procuring training equipment
to taste-testing ramen!
I'll assist you with anything, ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems her sincere attitude earned a fair amount of praise!
